s.how: Toss 300g mixed nuts with 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp caster sugar, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon and a pinch of salt. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 170C for 15 minutes, stirring halfway. Keep stirring as they cool so they don't clump.

s.note: round, gold and stamped like a subway token
s.how: Beat 200g soft butter with 100g icing sugar and mix in 300g plain flour to a dough. Roll 5mm thick, cut rounds the size of a subway token and cut a small hole from the middle of each. Bake at 160C for 15 minutes and cool. Brush with edible gold dust mixed with a drop of water.

m.note: Grace, the cop they both fall for, and her Puerto Rican cooking
m.how: Brown 800g chicken thighs and set aside. Fry 1 onion, 1 capsicum, 3 garlic cloves and a handful of coriander until soft, add 1 tsp ground annatto, 300g long grain rice, 60g green olives, 1 tbsp capers and 650ml chicken stock. Sit the chicken on top, cover and cook on low for 25 minutes until the rice is tender.

w.how: Rub 100g plain flour, 100g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 80g cold butter into big crumbs. Beat 125g butter with 125g caster sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour with 100ml milk. Spread in a lined 20cm tin, cover with the crumble and bake at 180C for 40 minutes.

d.how: Chill four 700ml tallboy cans of lager for at least 3 hours. Slide each into a brown paper bag, fold the top down around the can and hand them out on the subway platform.
